answer.reason: Many verses tell what happened at Babylon or to it: the captives taken there, a king freed there, and its foretold fall.

clauses.english: was where the people of Judah were carried captive by Nebuchadnezzar
clauses.quote: those carried he into captivity from Jerusalem to Babylon

clauses.english: was where Jehoiachin of Judah was freed from prison and honoured by Evilmerodach
clauses.quote: did lift up the head of Jehoiachin king of Judah out of prison

clauses.english: was foretold to be overthrown like Sodom and Gomorrah and never inhabited again
clauses.quote: shall be as when God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah

doubts: Many marked verses are about the king of Babylon or Nebuchadnezzar's deeds elsewhere, not about the city, so they were left out.
The fall of Babylon is given only as prophecy in the verses, so it is worded as foretold.
Verses that mention only the people called Babylonians or the Chaldeans were not used.
